Forwarding rules can be configured and enabled before a host or adapter is ready. Runtime failures remain visible and can be repaired with Reapply. The mapping policy selector is available before VPS selection.

Custom forwarding commands receive `{forwarding_type}` and `{rule_config_json}` for both Port mapping and Upstream pool. The editor explains the JSON contents and points to the public adapter contract.

Update the server, frontend and affected agents together. Custom adapter executables and command definitions must follow the [JSON argv contract](https://github.com/mnihyc/vpsman/blob/v0.5.40/docs/port-forwarding.md#custom-adapter-contract). No adapter executable is bundled.
